text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(With these legs, I shall carve my run,
our very existence, into the minds of the crowd!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Surpass Creek-san!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh!!
(Waaaaaahhhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(The raging flames burned to their absolute peak.
Even 'Union of Fire and Water' was performed to perfection...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's run today was so powerful!
I couldn't take my eyes off her...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, if only Oguri Cap had run...!
Oguri definitely would've won!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped if it's an injury. But seriously,
I wonder how it would've gone if Oguri had run.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ......Still not overturned, I see...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-chan had such an incredible, fiery spirit.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The air around Yaeno-chan grew hotter and hotter... I honestly thought I was going to be burned to ashes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "The feeling is mutual. I was desperately trying not to be swallowed up by you either, Creek-san."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I feel like I've gotten
a little closer to the real Yaeno-chan, and that makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if we can get even closer next time?
I'll be looking forward to it~

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...She's a bottomless mystery...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Today, I achieved a truly satisfying "Union of Fire and Water"!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a fantastic run full of fighting spirit!
Yeah, that was a fantastic run overflowing with fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Through “obsession,”
all my focus has turned toward the path to my goal,
and I feel everything has become crystal clear...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My heart burned with even greater intensity than before,
and the sheer determination to defeat Creek-san
drove me forward.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Though the fire raged within, it never ran wild.
It was under absolute control!
choice_data_list: Your 'Fire and Water Unity' level has gone up!
Your 'Fire and Water Unity' level went up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However... it seems my run failed to leave an impression on the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My running hasn't surpassed Oguri-san,
who is etched so deeply into people's memories...!
Just as she said, even though Oguri Cap wasn't running today, her name and strength were being talked about everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I really do have to beat Oguri-san!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To raise our own worth,
we must defeat Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now that I have attained “obsession” and can
control it perfectly!
—I can even defeat Oguri-san!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono! For our next race, it is my intention to clash directly with Oguri-san's entry!

Oguri Cap's injuries have been healing nicely,
and I hear she's started conditioning
with her sights set on the Yasuda Kinen.
choice_data_list: Apparently, she's going to run in the Yasuda Kinen
Apparently, she's going to run in the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Then, the Yasuda Kinen, please!

Next is the Yasuda Kinen. Yaeno Muteki
takes on a battle she cannot afford to lose against Oguri Cap!
